paragraphs: I am Tom, and this is our trip plan. Our class goes to a lake. There are thirty children in the class. Four grown-ups come with us. We meet at school at eight o'clock. Ben has a big bag of fruit for the trip. First, we drive to the lake by bus. The bus has forty seats. Six seats have no one. "We can put our bags there!" says Ben.

Second, we go to an island in the lake. Three small boats take us. Every boat takes ten children. Sam asks, "Can we swim?" "No," says our teacher. "Please sit with your group." We sit in the boat and look at the water. It is blue and quiet. The boat trip is short, and we are happy.

Third, we work in five groups on the island. Every group finds twenty leaves. A leaf can be red, green, or yellow. Sam finds a big red leaf. Then we count all the leaves two times. We have one hundred leaves! After lunch, we dance on the grass. We help the grown-ups clean the island. I like this plan. Do you want to come?
